blocks.title: Operator precedence
blocks.text: Operator precedence decides the order in which operations in an expression are performed. In Python, as in mathematics, some operators have higher precedence and are done first.
For example, in 3 + 2 * 5 the multiplication is done first: 3 + 10 = 13. Using parentheses makes complex expressions clearer and makes sure the operations happen in the intended order (Did You Know).
